whyq.intro: Join us at Q-Summit to unlock unparalleled opportunities for networking and innovation. Experience insights from industry leaders and connect with like-minded professionals eager to shape the future.

audiences.heading: Why Attendees Love the Q-Summit Experience
audiences.intro: Dive into the entrepreneurial spirit at Q-Summit 2027! Enjoy keynotes, panel discussions, and interactive formats like speed dating, workshops, and campfire sessions. Network with students, alumni, startups, VCs, and industry leaders. With over 100 partners, gain valuable resources and expand your network. Don’t miss the evening events and after-party, where connections and ideas thrive. Q-Summit is where innovation meets opportunity – join us!
audiences.imageAlt: Attendees networking in the crowd at Q-Summit

audiences.heading: Why Startups love the Q-Summit
audiences.intro: Be part of Q-Summit 2027 and drive innovation! Meet your future employees and motivated students and showcase your brand. Don't miss the opportunity to network with industry leaders and investors. Apply for our Pitchbattle or showcase your innovation in the Qube and impress investors and potential collaborators - don't miss your chance to innovate, inspire and grow!

audiences.heading: Unlock Opportunities: Why Partners choose Q-Summit
audiences.intro: As a partner, you'll gain the opportunity to showcase your brand, share expertise, and build impactful connections. Enjoy exclusive benefits like hosting a booth in Innovillage to present your innovations to 1,500+ participants, networking with 80+ partners and leaders, and leading workshops. You’ll also have access to partner-only check-ins, personalized support, and private workspaces. The Q-Summit is the perfect platform to position your company as an innovation leader, recruit top talent, and collaborate with forward-thinking professionals.

audiences.heading: More than just another Summit - why Founders visit the Q-Summit
audiences.intro: For founders, this is a unique opportunity to present ideas, expand networks, and gain exposure in an inspiring environment. At the heart of the event is the Qube, where founders can showcase their ventures and pitch to a diverse audience. The Pitch Battle allows participants to compete for exclusive prizes while receiving feedback from investors and partners. Founders can also connect with potential investors, collaborators, and motivated students eager to join innovative teams.

program.title: Program
program.metaDescription: Get a better idea of what Q-Summit has to offer you day and night.

agenda.heading: Conference Agenda
agenda.intro: Join us for two engaging days filled with insightful sessions. Explore topics that matter to you and connect with industry leaders. Check out our App for a more detailed agenda!

items.title: Speeches
items.description: Both days will feature a variety of sessions starting at 10:00 AM, designed to provide valuable insights and foster engaging discussions. The Main Stage opening will take place from 10:00 AM to 10:15 AM.

items.title: Workshops
items.description: Join interactive workshops hosted by our partners and work on real challenges with practical, hands-on solutions. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, strengthen your collaboration and problem-solving skills, and gain valuable insights from industry professionals. Applications for these formats have already closed. However, a waitlist will be available through our event app in case spots become available.

items.title: Speed-Datings
items.description: s a student, this is your chance to meet successful startups and VCs in a more personal setting. Connect directly with founders, CEOs, and managers, ask your questions, and gain valuable insights into entrepreneurship, investing, and building a business. If you feel inspired by the entrepreneurial spirit, you may even discover internship opportunities with the startup or VC of your choice. Applications for this format have already closed. However, a waitlist will be available through our event app in case spots become available.

items.title: Innovillage
items.description: Networking is at the heart of Q-Summit, and the Innovillage is the perfect place to connect. Visit company booths, build valuable relationships, expand your network, or simply enjoy the activities and experiences on offer. Whether you are looking for career opportunities, meaningful conversations, or just want to meet new people, the Innovillage is designed to help you make connections throughout the day.

items.title: Pitchbattle
items.description: The Pitch Battle at Q-Summit is where bold ideas meet expert feedback. Selected startups present their innovative concepts to a panel of judges and a live audience of Q-Summit attendees. The winner receives recognition, valuable prizes, and the opportunity to connect with industry leaders and investors. Applications for the Pitch Battle have already closed, but attendees can watch the event live on Friday from 6:00 PM to 7:30 PM on the Main Stage.

items.title: Qube
items.description: The Qube is Q-Summit’s exclusive pitching format, where selected startups have the opportunity to present directly to top-tier investors in a focused and private setting. Without the distractions of a large audience, startups can showcase their ideas to the people who matter most, making the Qube a valuable opportunity for funding, feedback, and strategic partnerships. Applications for the Qube have already closed.

items.title: Afterparty!
items.description: Join us for two unforgettable evenings at Mannheim’s iconic Schneckenhof. On Thursday, we will host our exclusive Theme Evening, while Friday night will feature the legendary Q-Summit Afterparty. Drinks will of course be provided, with support from our partners Rothaus, Absolut, Lillet, and Kleiner Klopfer.

schedule.intro: Familiarize yourself with upcoming program items and the general course of the Q-Summit Hackathon.

items.title: Opening
items.description: The event kicks off with an introduction to the Q-Summit Hackathon, setting the stage for two days of challenges and creativity. Participants will receive an overview of the schedule and expectations.

items.title: Hacking Start
items.description: Teams dive into the challenges, with a detailed explanation provided in advance. Participants begin brainstorming and working on their solutions.

items.title: Challenge Submission
items.description: Teams finalize their projects and submit their solutions for evaluation based on creativity, impact, and execution.

items.title: First Pitching Round
items.description: Teams present their progress and ideas to the judges, receiving feedback and guidance for further refinement.

items.title: Finalist Pitchbattle

panels.title: Europe's Edge - Founders Without Borders
panels.description: Europe’s true strength lies in its diversity. When founders collaborate across countries, cultures, and markets, ideas scale faster and become globally competitive. By breaking down borders, Europe can build companies that are resilient, innovative, and truly international from day one.

panels.title: Capital Meets Innovation
panels.description: Great ideas need the right partners to grow. A strong funding ecosystem brings founders and investors closer than ever before. When capital meets bold innovation, sustainable companies emerge - creating real impact across industries and society.

panels.title: Shaping Tomorrow With AI
panels.description: Artificial intelligence is not a passing trend, it is fundamentally redefining how we build, operate and innovate. From startups to global enterprises, AI is shaping the next generation of products and business models. Europe has the talent, responsibility and opportunity to lead this transformation.
